_readme: Static, manually verified 5-star reviews. Update procedure: docs/REVIEWS-QUARTERLY-UPDATE.md. Only rating 5 is ever displayed. 'text' is a short verbatim EXCERPT (opening sentence(s)); the card links to the full review on the platform.

items.author: A B
items.text: Hell of a trip… With in 15 mins of leaving the marina we were pulling in bonito. … Good conversation, organized and productive fishing made a perfect trip.

items.author: Agnes xE Benitez
items.text: I’ve been a loyal client of Exotic for over 15 years… An excursion with Exotic is always pure joy: impeccable vibes, effortless elegance, and, of course, fish… an abundance of fish!

items.author: Robert Saykally
items.text: Like always a great day on the water!!

items.author: Chloe Turner
items.text: Had the BEST TIME!!! He works hard to put you on the roosters! I caught a massive 70 + pounder in ten minutes…

items.author: Matt Stanford
items.text: We had an incredible time fishing with Exotic!! … It was pretty much non stop action and ended up being such a great day to remember for me and my kids.

items.author: Stella M
items.title: Had an incredible morning
items.text: Had an incredible morning out with Exotic Fish Cabo! We landed 3 beautiful 60 lb tuna and even hooked into a striped marlin.

items.author: crypton A
items.title: HUGE yellowfin tuna
items.text: I just had the best morning fishing with Exotic Fish Cabo! We caught a bunch of yellowfin tuna, including a HUGE one that my daughter managed to reel in all by herself…

items.author: Alhuero
items.title: Sunday Morning Catch!
items.text: They knew we were all inexperienced fisherman and they basically took care of everything except reeling in the fish! We caugt 4 Yellow fin tuna…

items.author: Cabo Casita Keeper
items.title: Marlins and tuna in the same morning
items.text: Marlins and tuna in the same morning... unheard of! … NEVER disappointed and always plenty of catches.
